How the recognizer works

The scanner builds a trie-based deterministic finite automaton (DFA). Starting at q0, each character follows one transition. Reaching an accepting state marks a complete term; word boundaries prevent matching “he” inside “the.”

Built-in vocabulary: he → they; she → they; him → them; her → them/their; chairman → chairperson; stewardess → flight attendant; policeman → police officer; fireman → firefighter; manpower → workforce; mankind → humankind; salesman → salesperson; businessman → businessperson; spokesman → spokesperson; mailman → mail carrier; waitress → server; ladies and gentlemen → everyone.
